title: blob-server memory conversions: ustar archive/extract, deferred results, stub converter
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B6. Crates: jmap-blob-server. Size: M.

Per docs/design/blobext.md §7 and docs/design/DECISIONS.md decision 13: memory/convert.rs with a hand-rolled ustar application/x-tar archive and extract (no new dependencies), archive results stored Deferred until first read (blob_info/read_blob_range materialize), every other recipe advertised null; test-helpers knobs stub_converter_for_test(Fn(&Recipe)->Result<Vec<u8>,SetError>) for image/compress/delta/patch, fail_deferred_for_test(id) (failed generation = not found everywhere, blobext-03 §8), omit_no_persist_for_test(true). Specs: blobext-03 §8, §8.2-§8.4. Acceptance: a tar built from known entries matches a hand-computed ustar header oracle (name, mode, size, checksum fields); extract lists the same entries; deferred size is null until read; fail_deferred makes blob_info return None.
